drafted_from: workflow row in tools/workflows/recipes/workflows.json (input_schema and the six steps with their submit shapes); read from the row's words, no test runs it
start_here: Say to your AI: "Run workflow:question-the-belief-until-it-holds on the belief: small bakeries cannot win customers from the big chain without discounts, for my pursuit Sunrise Bakery."
no_lists_because: The item names no list in its own words, input or steps, so it has no example rows to ship.
instructions: 1. Write the belief in your own words (at least 3 characters); add the pursuit it serves and any context you have.
2. Say "Run workflow:question-the-belief-until-it-holds". The AI starts it with tool:start-a-recipe-run and works the steps state, limits, evidence, revise, test, recurse.
3. At limits, read each assumed limit marked observed, inferred, inherited or imagined, with what would show it wrong; at evidence, read each source and what it does not establish.
4. At test, read the smallest real test, what is counted and the threshold; run it with workflow:possibility-to-proof when it should be run.
5. At recurse, read what changed in the method itself and which level to question next, then run the workflow again on that level.

worked_examples.title: A belief about discounts turns into a checked limit list
worked_examples.ask: Question my belief that a small bakery cannot win customers without discounts.

input.belief: Small bakeries cannot win customers from the big chain without discounts.
